name: polyv-live
description: Official PolyV live connector by YiFang Information Technology. Manage live channels, stream keys and status, playbacks, products, coupons, sessions, chat, viewers, watch conditions, platform settings and live statistics via the polyv-live-cli.
description_zh: 易方信息科技旗下保利威（PolyV）官方连接器：通过 polyv-live-cli 管理直播频道、推流与开播状态、回放、商品、优惠券、场次、聊天、观众、观看条件、平台设置与直播统计。
description_en: Official PolyV live connector by YiFang Information Technology. Manage live channels, stream keys and status, playbacks, products, coupons, sessions, chat, viewers, watch conditions, platform settings and live statistics via the polyv-live-cli.
examples_zh: 看看我现在的直播频道和状态
复盘一下上一场直播的观看数据
帮我创建一个电商场景的直播频道
查一下某个频道的回放列表
examples_en: Show my live channels and their status
Review the viewer data of my last session
Create a channel for my e-commerce live
List the replays of a channel
